```yaml
severity: ERROR

pattern: |
  $PATTERN1 = "from django.utils.html import mark_safe"
  $PATTERN2 = "return mark_safe(string_concat"

    - "$PATTERN1"
    - "$PATTERN2"
    - "$PATTERN3"
taint-mode:
  taint-sinks:
    - name: "mark_safe"
      position: "before"
    - name: "format_html"
      position: "before"
```
